description: Config for the shared file screener. Screening runs ONLY for the channels listed in Active Channels, and ONLY while the Storage::File::screening toggle is on. Every field here may be left blank, and a blank field is the shipped default, never 'nothing' — the code holds the default, this form holds the departure from it. Allowed file extensions are NOT set here: System Settings > Files owns that list, for this screener and for Frappe alike.

fields.label: ClamAV Host
fields.description: clamd host. Blank = clamav (the compose service).

fields.label: ClamAV Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: How long the scan is waited for before the scanner is treated as unreachable. It is paid on the upload the patient or partner is waiting on, so a long timeout is felt as a slow form rather than a fast refusal. Blank = 30.

fields.label: If Scanner Unavailable
fields.description: When clamd cannot be reached: block (fail-closed, refuse the upload) or allow (accept it on the magic-byte sniff alone). This verdict is not a fact about the file but an outage of ours, which is why it is decided here rather than in Blocking Verdicts, and why a partner is answered 'try again' rather than 'your file was invalid'. Blank = block.

fields.label: Active Channels
fields.description: Screening runs ONLY for the channels listed here. Add a row to activate a channel (Intake, Partner API); remove it to deactivate. Empty = dormant even with the toggle on.

fields.label: Blocking Verdicts
fields.description: Which verdicts refuse the upload. Add a row per verdict; remove it to stop that verdict refusing anything. A verdict left off the grid is still reached, still logged and still visible in File Scan Log — it simply no longer stops the file, which is how a new check is watched before it is enforced. Scanner Unavailable is not offered here: it is an outage of ours rather than a fact about the file, and it is decided by its own field above. Empty = all three block.

fields.label: Scan Log Retention (days)
fields.description: How long a per-upload verdict is kept in File Scan Log before Log Settings' daily cleanup removes it. The trim only runs while the Storage::File::screening toggle is on, because the toggle is what registers this log with Log Settings. Blank = 90.

name: CRM File Screening Settings
